info.name: Have I Been Pwned API v3 Breach Breaches API
Get all breaches in the system

params.name: domain
params.description: Filters the result set to only breaches against the domain specified. It is possible that one site (and consequently domain), is compromised on multiple occasions.

params.name: isSpamList
params.description: Filters the result set to only breaches that either are or are not flagged as a spam list.

items.docs: Returns the full breach catalogue. This endpoint is unauthenticated, but it still requires a user-agent header.
